study_type_evidence.quote: PK profiles of glucagon, α/sulfono-γ-AApeptide hybrid analogues 15 and 19 were investigated after a single dose of 5 mg/kg (i.v).
The serum stabilities of peptides were determined in 25% (v/v) aqueous-pooled serum from human male AB plasma.
study_type_evidence.section: METHODS (In Vitro Human Serum Stability Assay)

study_type_evidence.quote: HEK293 cells that stably overexpressed GCGR with the CRE-responsive firefly luciferase reporter were stimulated with glucagon as the positive control and the peptide samples for 16 h

in_vivo_species.strain_sex_age: wild-type C57BL/6J; PK study used 8-week-old female and male mice, 20-30 g; pharmacodynamics used 8-week-old female mice, 20-30 g
in_vivo_species.quote: Twelve 8-week-old female and male mice weighing 20–30 g were prepared and divided into three groups (4 males and 4 females in each group).

ex_vivo_detail: Serum stability assay in 25% (v/v) aqueous pooled serum from human male AB plasma; peptides diluted to 2 mg/mL and incubated at 37 °C for 24 h, then protein-precipitated with acetonitrile and the intact peptide quantified by RP-HPLC peak area at 215 nm. Classified ex vivo because serum removed from human donors is the test matrix.
in_vitro_detail: CRE-driven firefly luciferase reporter assay in HEK293 cells stably overexpressing human GCGR; intracellular cAMP HTRF assay in CHO-K1 cells stably overexpressing hGCGR; circular dichroism of peptides at 100 μM in PBS; PyMOL modelling against glucagon crystal structure PDB 1GCN.

agents.name: α/sulfono-γ-AApeptide hybrid analogue 15
agents.sequence: H-HAibQGTFTSDYSKYLDSRRAQDFVQWLX1T-NH2 (Aib = 2-aminoisobutyric acid; X1 = sulfono-gamma-AA residue replacing Met27-Asn28; C-terminal amide)
agents.chemical_identifier: EC50 0.86 nM in the CRE-Luc GCGR functional assay (Table 1)
agents.group_n: Methods state twelve mice in three groups, described as 4 males and 4 females in each group (internally inconsistent); half the mice sampled at the first 3 timepoints and half at the last 4
agents.group_n_quote: divided into three groups (4 males and 4 females in each group) ... (half mice for the first 3 time points and another half for the last 4 time points to avoid ischemic shock)
agents.dose: 5 mg/kg for PK; 50 μg/kg (low) and 500 μg/kg (high) for pharmacodynamics
agents.dose_route_quote: after a single dose of 5 mg/kg (i.v). For each group, blood samples were obtained at 15 min, 30 min, 1 h, 2 h, 4 h, 8 h, and 24 h after injection
agents.pk_quote: the lead linear α/sulfono-γ-AApeptide hybrid analogue 15 exhibited a significant increase in half-life (~4 h, Figure 7A)

agents.name: α/sulfono-γ-AApeptide hybrid analogue 19
agents.sequence: H-HAibQGTFTSDYSKYLDSKTailRAQDFVQWLX1T-NH2 (Aib = 2-aminoisobutyric acid; KTail = lysine bearing the long fatty acid/PEG tail; X1 = sulfono-gamma-AA residue; C-terminal amide)
agents.chemical_identifier: fatty-acid tail introduced on solid phase using Fmoc-OcO2-OH, N-Fmoc-Glu(OH)-OtBu or 18-(tert-butoxy)-18-oxooctadecanoic acid; EC50 12.63 nM in the CRE-Luc assay
agents.group_n: Methods state twelve mice in three groups, described as 4 males and 4 females in each group (internally inconsistent)
agents.group_n_quote: Twelve 8-week-old female and male mice weighing 20–30 g were prepared and divided into three groups
agents.dose: 5 mg/kg for PK; 50 μg/kg (low) and 500 μg/kg (high) for pharmacodynamics
agents.dose_route_quote: PK of glucagon and α/sulfono-γ-AApeptide hybrid analogues 15 and 19 (5 mg/kg, i.v) in mice over 24 h.
agents.half_life: not reported (described only qualitatively as 'much more enhanced stability compared with glucagon')
agents.pk_quote: the lead compound 19, which combined unnatural residues and long fatty acid conjugation, showed much more enhanced stability compared with glucagon

agents.name: Glucagon
agents.chemical_identifier: EC50 0.03 nM in the CRE-Luc GCGR functional assay (Table 1)
agents.group_n: Methods state twelve mice in three groups, described as 4 males and 4 females in each group; n = 5 per group in the pharmacodynamics study
agents.group_n_quote: Data are mean ± SD, statistical evaluation was performed using one-way ANOVA, followed by a Bonferroni test when appropriate, n = 5.
agents.dose: 5 mg/kg for PK; 50 μg/kg (Glucagon-L) and 500 μg/kg (Glucagon-H) for pharmacodynamics
agents.dose_route_quote: mice in each group were administered with saline and 50 and 500 μg/kg of drugs (glucagon, α/sulfono-γ-AApeptide hybrid analogues 15 and 19) by intravenous injection
agents.half_life: not reported numerically; undetectable in blood after 15 min
agents.pk_quote: Consistent with previous findings, glucagon was metabolized quickly and was not found in blood after 15 min.

agents.group_n_quote: The activity of these α/sulfono-γ-AApeptide hybrids 1–10 (Table 1) was first determined using a cAMP response element (CRE)-driven luciferase reporter
agents.dose_route_quote: stably expressing human GCGR obtained with O8 as the control (Figure 3)

agents.name: Saline
agents.group_n_quote: Thirty-five 8-week-old female mice with body weight in the range 20–30 g were prepared and equally divided into 7 groups.
agents.dose_route_quote: mice in each group were administered with saline and 50 and 500 μg/kg of drugs ... by intravenous injection

agents.name: Insulin
agents.group_n: n = 5 per group (35 mice in 7 groups)

concentration_time_figure.caption_quote: PK of glucagon and α/sulfono-γ-AApeptide hybrid analogues 15 and 19 (5 mg/kg, i.v) in mice over 24 h.
concentration_time_figure.note: Plasma level of each peptide plotted against time after a single 5 mg/kg i.v. dose; sampling at 15 min, 30 min, 1, 2, 4, 8 and 24 h. Figure 7B is a pharmacodynamic blood-glucose vs time plot, not a concentration-time curve. Figure 6D,E show RP-HPLC serum-stability traces rather than %-remaining vs time.

bioanalytical_method: LC-MS/MS of plasma after acetonitrile/glacial acetic acid (9:1) protein precipitation; RP-HPLC (215 nm) for the human serum stability assay
bioanalytical_quote: The samples were allowed to rest on ice for 15 min and centrifuged at 10,000 rpm and 4 °C for 15 min. The clarified supernatants were analyzed by LC/MS/MS.
notes: Only one numeric in vivo half-life appears in the body (~4 h, attributed to analogue 15); no half-life value is given for glucagon or analogue 19, and no Cmax/Tmax/AUC are reported anywhere. The PK group size is internally inconsistent: 'Twelve ... mice ... divided into three groups (4 males and 4 females in each group)' cannot both be true (12 total would give 4 per group). The sentence reporting the ~4 h value is ambiguous in construction because it first praises compound 19 and then attributes the numeric half-life to compound 15; the value is recorded under 15 as written. Residue codes X1-X5 denote different sulfono-gamma-AA building blocks and KTail denotes the fatty-acid-conjugated lysine; the body does not expand these into standard one-letter codes. Human serum stability: analogue 19 showed no detectable degradation while glucagon showed >85% degradation over 24 h.
